**Article Details for PMID: 42994867**

**Title:** Comparative efficacy and safety of second- and later-line BRAF-targeted regimens in BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer: A systematic review and network meta-analysis.

**Authors:** Muhammad Arsalan, F N U Sawaira, Irtaza Hassan, Taimoor Hassan, Mavra Khan, Muhammad Yasir, Shariq Hayat, Muhammad Junaid, Hassaan Qazi, Sarim Hassan Shahab, Aizaz Anwar, Owais Gul, Mohammad Al Diab Al Azzawi

**Journal:** Medicine
**Publication Date:** 2026-11-06
**DOI:** 10.1097/MD.0000000000051468

**Abstract:**
BRAF V600E mutations occur in approximately 8 to 12% of metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) cases and define an aggressive phenotype with poor prognosis. While the BEACON CRC trial established encorafenib-based combinations as effective second-line options, direct head-to-head comparisons among available BRAF-targeted regimens are lacking. This network meta-analysis (NMA) compared the relative efficacy and safety of second- and later-line BRAF-targeted regimens in BRAF V600E-mutant mCRC.
